props.description: The height of an hour in px. Default 46, or 40 inside a compact tile.

props.name: layout
props.description: "auto" shows the week while each day gets `minDayWidth`, then day tabs. Default "auto".

props.name: minDayWidth
props.description: The narrowest a day column may get before "auto" switches to day tabs. Default 60.

props.name: day
props.description: The day shown in day tabs (controlled).

props.name: defaultDay
props.description: The day shown first in day tabs. Default today, else the first day.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Makes each event a button and is called with it.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the category legend under the grid. Default true.

props.name: locale
props.description: Number and date language. Default "en-GB".

items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for tier, category, new and demo data: neutral, free, pro, new and demo variants that read in light and dark.

props.name: variant
props.description: What the label means, which sets how loud it is: - `neutral`: a category or any plain tag ("controls", "surfaces"), set in mono on a faint fill. The default. - `free`: free or open source ("Free", "MIT"), a hairline outline that steps back. - `pro`: the paid tier ("Pro"), inverted to the page's text colour, so it is the one label that stands out. - `new`: recently added ("New"), a raised key with a small success dot. The word carries the meaning, not the dot. - `demo`: marks example data ("Demo data"), a dashed outline, so made-up figures never pass for real ones.

props.name: children
props.description: The visible text. Keep it to a word or two.

a11y.text: Plain text in a span, not interactive. Pass an id and point a link's aria-describedby at it, so the tier is read with the link.

items.name: gallery-card
items.title: Gallery card
items.description: A catalogue card: a poster or a drawn fallback with the name, a loop video on hover or focus, the tier badge, category and new, and one link stretched over the card.

props.name: name
props.description: The item's name (a slug like "flux-image"). It is the link text and, without a poster, the poster.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the card leads. Always a real URL, so the card works without JS and opens in a new tab on Cmd/Ctrl click.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences; clamped to two lines.

props.name: descriptionLang
props.description: The language of the description, when it differs from the page (e.g. English descriptions on a Danish page).

props.name: tier
props.description: Which tier badge to show.

props.name: category
props.description: A category label under the description, e.g. "surfaces".

props.name: isNew
props.description: Marks the item as recently added.

props.name: poster
props.description: Poster image (16:10). Decorative: the name is the link text. Without one, or if it fails, the card draws its own.

props.name: loop
props.description: A short muted video that loops on hover and focus. Fetched on first hover/focus; never plays under reduced motion.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called on a plain click or Enter instead of navigating, e.g. to open a detail view. Modified clicks keep the link.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of the name.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible string, for other languages.

a11y.text: One Tab stop per card: the name is the link and covers the card. Focus starts the loop like hover does. With onOpen, a plain click or Enter opens the detail view; Cmd, Ctrl and middle click keep the link.
The link is described by the tier badge and the description (aria-describedby). The video and the Enter hint are aria-hidden.
The loop never plays under reduced motion; the poster stays.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: A tier switch (All, Free, Pro, New, with counts from props) and a scrolling row of category chips. Both are plain links, so it filters without JavaScript; with onChange it filters in place.

props.name: value
props.description: The current filter and category. Read it from the URL on the server so the bar renders right without JS.

props.name: counts
props.description: How many items each tier holds for the current category.

props.name: categories
props.description: The category chips in the order to show them, each with its count for the current tier (0 is fine).

props.name: allCount
props.description: The count on the "all" chip. Defaults to the sum of the category counts.

props.name: hrefFor
props.description: Builds the link for a state. Defaults to `?filter=<tier>&kat=<category>`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Filter in place: a plain click or Enter calls this instead of following the link.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Keys 1 to 4 pick a tier from anywhere on the page. Off: no keys, no hints, no aria-keyshortcuts.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible string, for other languages.

a11y.text: Every tier and chip is a link in the Tab order. Keys 1 to 4 pick a tier; they are ignored while typing or when a modal is open, and shortcuts={false} removes them with their hints and aria-keyshortcuts. Focus stays on the chosen link.
Two labelled nav landmarks; the active link has aria-current. A polite status says what is shown. The chip scroller arrows are aria-hidden with tabIndex -1, since every chip is reachable by Tab.
The tier indicator slides with transform; under reduced motion it moves at once.

items.name: preview-stage
items.title: Preview stage
items.description: A measured preview frame: a width switch with a ruler and shutters, scale to fit, light and dark, reload and open in a new tab, plus loading and error states with try again.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the stage and the iframe ("data-tile demo").

props.name: src
props.description: A page to show in an iframe.

props.name: children
props.type: ReactNode | ((view: { width: number; theme: StageTheme }) => ReactNode)
props.description: Or your own content. As a function it gets the width and theme; plain nodes get the `dark` class in dark.

props.name: themeParam
props.description: Builds the iframe URL for a theme. By default it sets `mode=light|dark` in the query and keeps the rest.

props.name: widths
props.description: The widths to switch between, in CSS px.

props.name: width
props.description: The width, if you control it.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: The first width when you do not. Defaults to the widest.

props.name: theme
props.description: The content's theme, if you control it.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the states yourself. Without it, an iframe is loading until it loads, and `children` are ready.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Called on Reload and Try again (the stage reloads its own iframe or remounts `children` either way).

props.name: timeout
props.description: Milliseconds an iframe may take, counted once it is in view, before the stage shows the error.

props.name: caption
props.description: A line beside the frame note, e.g. where the demo comes from.

props.name: height
props.description: The window's height. Defaults to clamp(300px, 48vh, 540px).

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: W and T while focus is in the stage. Off: no keys, no hints, no aria-keyshortcuts.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and announced string, for other languages.

a11y.text: The width switch is a radio group with one Tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move it. The theme control is a switch. W and T change width and theme only while focus is inside the stage, and shortcuts={false} turns them off. Try again moves focus to Reload.
The stage is a group named by title. A polite status announces width, theme, loading and error. Icon buttons have names; the ruler and shutters are aria-hidden.
The shutters and scale use transform; under reduced motion they jump to the end state. The loader shows only after 300 ms.

items.name: locked-code
items.title: Locked code
items.description: A locked Pro file: a blurred stub, an unlock link with the price, the facts, and the CLI and MCP commands to copy once you have a key.

props.name: name
props.description: The component's name, such as "flux-image". Used in the text and, with ".tsx", as the file name.

props.name: filename
props.description: The file name in the header. Default `${name}.tsx`.

props.name: stub
props.description: Placeholder lines drawn blurred behind the lock. They ship in the page's HTML, so never pass the real source: a few generic lines (imports, a props type, an empty function) are enough to read as code.

props.name: unlockHref
props.description: Where the unlock link goes, such as the pricing section.

props.name: onUnlock
props.description: Called when the unlock link is clicked, for opening a checkout in place. Call `preventDefault()` to stay.

props.name: price
props.description: The price after the unlock label, such as "€49". Leave it out for a plain "Unlock".

props.name: priceNote
props.description: One line under the link about the price, such as an introductory offer and when it ends.

props.name: facts
props.description: Short facts in a row under the price, such as "One-time payment".

props.name: commands
props.description: The commands that fetch the code with a key, each with a copy button. Leave it empty to drop the key row.

props.name: envVar
props.description: The environment variable the key lives in, shown in the key row.

props.name: setupHref
props.description: A page that explains how to set the key up, linked from the key row.

props.name: labels
props.description: Words for other languages.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of "The code is locked", to fit the page outline. Default 3.

a11y.text: Tab order: Unlock, How to set it up, Copy CLI, Copy MCP. The key slot lights on hover and on keyboard focus.

A region named by the file name and heading. The stub is aria-hidden: pass placeholder lines, never real source, since it ships in the HTML. Each command row is a group named after its command, so each Copy says what it copies.

items.name: command-search
items.title: Command search
items.description: A search field that opens a Cmd+K palette on the native dialog, with grouped results, a preview pane for the active result, and a no-results state with suggestions.

props.name: items
props.description: Everything that can be found. Counts in the palette are taken from this list.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item after the palette has closed. Without it, the item's `href` is followed.

props.name: renderPreview
props.description: Your own preview for the active item, in place of the poster, title, description, badges and install line.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Searches to offer when nothing matches, shown with their hit counts (ones with no hits are left out, at most four). A function gets the query, for mapping words in another language. Default: the commonest categories.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Single-key shortcuts: "/" opens the search. Turn off for WCAG 2.1.4; Cmd/Ctrl+K keeps working. Default true.

props.name: hotkeys
props.description: Listen on the whole page for Cmd/Ctrl+K (and "/"). Turn off on a second search on the same page. Default true.

props.name: limit
props.description: Results per group while searching. Default 8.

props.name: initialLimit
props.description: Results per group with an empty field. Default 5.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the palette is open. Leave it out to let the component keep track.

props.name: query
props.description: Controls the text in the field (the trigger and the palette share it).

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The starting text, such as `?q=` from the URL.

props.name: action
props.description: Where the trigger form sends `?q=` without JavaScript. Default: the current page.

props.name: name
props.description: The query parameter's name. Default "q".

props.name: labels
props.description: Words for other languages.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the trigger field.

a11y.text: Cmd or Ctrl+K toggles it, and / opens it unless you are typing in a field or shortcuts={false}. Typing in the trigger opens it with the text. Arrow keys wrap, Home and End jump, Enter opens, Cmd+Enter copies the install line, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

A modal native dialog with a combobox and a listbox; aria-activedescendant is set only when an option is active. Each group is role=group. The hit count is announced politely after typing stops, and the copy toast is a status.
Under reduced motion it opens and closes without animation; keyboard opens are always instant.
